nodes.label: AIS WebSocket persistent daemon worker
nodes.rationale: Persistent wss connection with bounding-box subscriptions, in-memory state and 15s reconnect backoff delivers real-time congestion and vessel availability proxy.

nodes.label: APScheduler daily_all and hourly_congestion jobs
nodes.rationale: Daily sync for freight/commodities/bunker/congestion plus hourly AIS congestion upserts keeps DB fresh without blocking request path.

nodes.label: On-Demand Fetching with DB fallback
nodes.rationale: Fetch live at request time then merge with PostgreSQL where newer wins, falling back to DB-only on API failure, to keep optimization populated even when external APIs fail.

nodes.label: Spot vs Multi-Voyage Contract Strategy
nodes.rationale: Compare program-basis cost N x spot minus contract with risk and confidence to decide whether spot exposure or contract cover minimizes total cost; headline savings read off winner.
